label: Churn PIT Training Set
name: ChurnPITTrainingSet
description: Point-in-time training set: monthly snapshots of the active book labelled on preventable voluntary cancellation in the following 60/90 days

fields.formulaExpression: case when to_timestamp(Snapshot_Date__c) <= now() - INTERVAL 61 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Label window closed (snapshot older than 61 days)
fields.name: Window_Closed

fields.formulaExpression: to_timestamp(Snapshot_Date__c)
fields.label: Snap Date (timestamp so it compares with event datetimes)
fields.name: Snap_Date

fields.formulaExpression: date_format(Snapshot_Date__c, 'yyyyMM')
fields.label: Snap Key (yyyyMM)
fields.name: Snap_Key

fields.formulaExpression: lower(Email__c)
fields.label: Email key (lowercased)
fields.name: Email_Key

fields.formulaExpression: case when Policy_Effective_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" and CreatedDate__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" and (Cancel_Date_c__c is null or Cancel_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date") then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: In book at snapshot
fields.name: In_Book

fields.formulaExpression: case when Offer_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" and Offer_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 60 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Offer issued in the 60 days before the snapshot
fields.name: Offer_In_Window

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (offer)
fields.name: Snap_Key_Offer

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" and Cancel_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" + INTERVAL 60 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Cancel within 60d
fields.name: Cancel_In_60d

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" and Cancel_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" + INTERVAL 90 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Cancel within 90d
fields.name: Cancel_In_90d

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancellation_Reason_c__c in ('Due to high premium','Replacement of insurance carrier','Insured request - other','App issue / UX','Due to poor customer service','Due to poor claims service') then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Preventable voluntary reason
fields.name: Preventable

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_In_60d = 1 and Preventable = 1 then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Label 60d
fields.name: Label_60

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_In_90d = 1 and Preventable = 1 then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Label 90d
fields.name: Label_90

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_In_60d = 1 and Preventable = 0 then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Censored (non-pay, company, unpreventable in window)
fields.name: Censored

fields.formulaExpression: case when Cancel_In_90d = 1 then Cancellation_Reason_c__c else null end
fields.label: Reason (evaluation only)
fields.name: Reason

fields.formulaExpression: concat(Id__c, '_', "Cal.Snap_Key")
fields.label: Row key
fields.name: Row_Key

fields.formulaExpression: datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", CreatedDate__c)
fields.label: Tenure days
fields.name: Tenure_Days

fields.formulaExpression: datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", Policy_Effective_Date_c__c)
fields.label: Days since policy effective
fields.name: Policy_Days

fields.formulaExpression: case when Tenure_Days < 180 then 'lt6mo' when Tenure_Days < 365 then '6to12mo' when Tenure_Days < 730 then '1to2y' else '2yplus' end
fields.label: Tenure bucket
fields.name: Tenure_Bucket

fields.formulaExpression: Policy_Days - 182 * floor(Policy_Days / 182)
fields.label: Days into term (estimated from 6-month terms)
fields.name: Days_Into_Term_Est

fields.formulaExpression: 182 - (Policy_Days - 182 * floor(Policy_Days / 182))
fields.label: Days to term end (estimated)
fields.name: Days_To_Term_End_Est

fields.formulaExpression: case when Policy_Renewal_Date_c__c >= "Cal.Snap_Date" then datediff(Policy_Renewal_Date_c__c, "Cal.Snap_Date") else null end
fields.label: Days to renewal (CURRENT VALUE: valid for latest snapshot only)
fields.name: Days_To_Renewal

fields.formulaExpression: case when Current_Term_Effective_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" and Current_Term_Expiration_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" then datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", Current_Term_Effective_Date_c__c) else null end
fields.label: Days into term (real; null when the current term was not in force at the snapshot)
fields.name: Days_Into_Term

fields.formulaExpression: case when Current_Term_Effective_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" and Current_Term_Expiration_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" then datediff(Current_Term_Expiration_Date_c__c, "Cal.Snap_Date") else null end
fields.label: Days to term end (real; same rule)
fields.name: Days_To_Term_End

fields.formulaExpression: case when Last_App_Open_Date_c__c is null or Last_App_Open_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" then null else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", Last_App_Open_Date_c__c) end
fields.label: Days since last app open (Contact field; null if after snapshot)
fields.name: Days_Since_Last_App_Open

fields.formulaExpression: "Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c"
fields.label: Renewal offer change $ (latest offer in the 60 days before the snapshot; point-in-time from Renewal_Offer__c)
fields.name: Renewal_Offer_Change_Dollars

fields.formulaExpression: "Acct.Off.Policy_Renewal_Rate_c__c"
fields.label: Renewal offer monthly rate
fields.name: Renewal_Offer_Rate

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Acct.Off.Policy_Renewal_Rate_c__c" - coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0) > 0 then 100 * coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0) / ("Acct.Off.Policy_Renewal_Rate_c__c" - coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0)) else null end
fields.label: Renewal offer change % (computed; the Salesforce formula fields arrive null through the connector)
fields.name: Renewal_Offer_Change_Pct

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Acct.Latest_Offer_Date" is null then null else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "Acct.Latest_Offer_Date") end
fields.label: Days since the latest offer (point-in-time)
fields.name: Days_Since_Renewal_Offer_PIT

fields.formulaExpression: "Acct.Off.Rating_Version_c__c"
fields.label: Rating version on the offer
fields.name: Renewal_Rating_Version

fields.formulaExpression: case when Renewal_Offer_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", Renewal_Offer_Date_c__c) else null end
fields.label: Days since renewal offer (CURRENT VALUE)
fields.name: Days_Since_Renewal_Offer

fields.formulaExpression: case when Event_Timestamp_UTC_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Event before snapshot
fields.name: App_Before_Snap

fields.formulaExpression: case when Event_Timestamp_UTC_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 30 DAY and Event_Timestamp_UTC_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: App event in 30d
fields.name: App_30

fields.formulaExpression: case when Event_Timestamp_UTC_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY and Event_Timestamp_UTC_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: App event in 90d
fields.name: App_90

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (app)
fields.name: Snap_Key_App

fields.formulaExpression: lower(et4ae5_Email_c__c)
fields.label: Email key (lowercased)
fields.name: Email_Key_I

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_DateSent_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Send before snapshot
fields.name: Email_Before_Snap

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_DateSent_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Sent in 90d
fields.name: Email_Sent_90

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_Opened_c__c = true and coalesce(et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c, et4ae5_DateSent_c__c) > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 30 DAY and coalesce(et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c, et4ae5_DateSent_c__c) <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Opened in 30d
fields.name: Email_Open_30

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_Opened_c__c = true and coalesce(et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c, et4ae5_DateSent_c__c) > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY and coalesce(et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c, et4ae5_DateSent_c__c) <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Opened in 90d
fields.name: Email_Open_90

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_Clicked_c__c = true and et4ae5_DateSent_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Clicked in 90d (attributed to send date)
fields.name: Email_Click_90

fields.formulaExpression: case when et4ae5_Opened_c__c = true and et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then et4ae5_DateOpened_c__c else et4ae5_DateSent_c__c end
fields.label: Email event date (open if before snapshot, else send)
fields.name: Email_Event_Date

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (email)
fields.name: Snap_Key_Email

fields.formulaExpression: case when Created_at_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Ticket before snapshot
fields.name: Tkt_Before_Snap

fields.formulaExpression: case when Created_at_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY and Created_at_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Ticket in 90d
fields.name: Tkt_90

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (ticket)
fields.name: Snap_Key_Tkt

fields.formulaExpression: (coalesce(subscore_display_safe_speeds_curr_month__c, 0) + coalesce(subscore_display_smooth_driving_curr_mon__c, 0) + coalesce(subscore_display_distracted_driving_curr__c, 0) + coalesce(subscore_display_driving_patterns_curr_m__c, 0)) / 4
fields.label: Cycle score (mean of the four display subscores)
fields.name: Drv_Score

fields.formulaExpression: case when cycle_end_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Cycle ended before snapshot
fields.name: Drv_Before_Snap

fields.formulaExpression: case when cycle_end_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 45 DAY and cycle_end_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Latest cycle (ended in the 45 days before)
fields.name: Drv_Latest_Window

fields.formulaExpression: case when cycle_end_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 135 DAY and cycle_end_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Prior cycle (ended 90 to 135 days before)
fields.name: Drv_Prior_Window

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 then Drv_Score else null end
fields.label: Score if latest
fields.name: Drv_Score_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Prior_Window = 1 then Drv_Score else null end
fields.label: Score if prior
fields.name: Drv_Score_Prior

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 then n_trips_in_curr_month_c__c else null end
fields.label: Trips if latest
fields.name: Drv_Trips_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 then distance_miles_in_curr_month_c__c else null end
fields.label: Miles if latest
fields.name: Drv_Miles_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 then earn_discount_curr_month_c__c else null end
fields.label: Earned discount if latest
fields.name: Drv_Discount_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Prior_Window = 1 then earn_discount_curr_month_c__c else null end
fields.label: Earned discount if prior
fields.name: Drv_Discount_Prior

fields.formulaExpression: case when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 and driver_role_c__c = 'PNI' then 1 when Drv_Latest_Window = 1 then 0 else null end
fields.label: PNI at latest cycle (historical)
fields.name: Drv_PNI_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (driving)
fields.name: Snap_Key_Drv

fields.formulaExpression: case when Invoice_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Invoice before snapshot
fields.name: Bill_Before_Snap

fields.formulaExpression: case when Invoice_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 35 DAY and Invoice_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Latest invoice (35 days)
fields.name: Bill_Latest_W

fields.formulaExpression: case when Invoice_Date_c__c > "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 125 DAY and Invoice_Date_c__c <= "Cal.Snap_Date" - INTERVAL 90 DAY then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Invoice ~3 months earlier
fields.name: Bill_Prior_W

fields.formulaExpression: case when Bill_Latest_W = 1 then Policy_Net_Bill_Amount_c__c else null end
fields.label: Net if latest
fields.name: Bill_Net_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: case when Bill_Prior_W = 1 then Policy_Net_Bill_Amount_c__c else null end
fields.label: Net if prior
fields.name: Bill_Net_Prior

fields.formulaExpression: case when Bill_Latest_W = 1 then Policy_Gross_Bill_Amount_c__c else null end
fields.label: Gross if latest
fields.name: Bill_Gross_Latest

fields.formulaExpression: "Cal.Snap_Key"
fields.label: Snap key (bill)
fields.name: Snap_Key_Bill

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("App.App_Events_30d", 0)
fields.label: App events 30d (final)
fields.name: App_Events_30d_F

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("App.App_Events_90d", 0)
fields.label: App events 90d (final)
fields.name: App_Events_90d_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "App.Last_App_Event" is null then 9999 else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "App.Last_App_Event") end
fields.label: Days since last app event
fields.name: Days_Since_Last_App_Event

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Email.Email_Sends_90d", 0)
fields.label: Emails sent 90d (final)
fields.name: Email_Sends_90d_F

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Email.Email_Opens_30d", 0)
fields.label: Email opens 30d (final)
fields.name: Email_Opens_30d_F

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Email.Email_Opens_90d", 0)
fields.label: Email opens 90d (final)
fields.name: Email_Opens_90d_F

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Email.Email_Clicks_90d", 0)
fields.label: Email clicks 90d (final)
fields.name: Email_Clicks_90d_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when coalesce("Email.Email_Sends_90d", 0) = 0 then null else coalesce("Email.Email_Opens_90d", 0) / "Email.Email_Sends_90d" end
fields.label: Email open rate 90d
fields.name: Email_Open_Rate_90d

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Email.Last_Email_Event" is null then 9999 else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "Email.Last_Email_Event") end
fields.label: Days since last email event
fields.name: Days_Since_Last_Email_Event

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Tkt.Tickets_90d", 0)
fields.label: Tickets 90d (final)
fields.name: Tickets_90d_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Tkt.Last_Ticket" is null then 9999 else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "Tkt.Last_Ticket") end
fields.label: Days since last ticket
fields.name: Days_Since_Last_Ticket

fields.formulaExpression: "Drv.Drv_Score_Latest_A"
fields.label: Driving score, latest cycle
fields.name: Drv_Score_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Drv.Drv_Score_Latest_A" is null or "Drv.Drv_Score_Prior_A" is null then null else "Drv.Drv_Score_Latest_A" - "Drv.Drv_Score_Prior_A" end
fields.label: Driving score trend (latest minus ~3 cycles earlier)
fields.name: Drv_Score_Trend

fields.formulaExpression: "Drv.Drv_Trips_Latest_A"
fields.label: Trips, latest cycle
fields.name: Drv_Trips_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: "Drv.Drv_Miles_Latest_A"
fields.label: Miles, latest cycle
fields.name: Drv_Miles_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A"
fields.label: Earned discount, latest cycle
fields.name: Drv_Discount_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A" is null or "Drv.Drv_Discount_Prior_A" is null then null else "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A" - "Drv.Drv_Discount_Prior_A" end
fields.label: Earned discount change vs ~3 cycles earlier
fields.name: Drv_Discount_Change

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Drv.Drv_Last_Cycle_End" is null then null else datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "Drv.Drv_Last_Cycle_End") end
fields.label: Days since the last driving cycle ended
fields.name: Days_Since_Last_Cycle

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Drv.Drv_Cycles", 0)
fields.label: Driving cycles before snapshot
fields.name: Drv_Cycles_F

fields.formulaExpression: "Drv.Drv_PNI_Latest_A"
fields.label: PNI at latest cycle (historical, 1/0/null)
fields.name: Drv_PNI_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: "Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A"
fields.label: Net premium, latest invoice
fields.name: Bill_Net_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A" is null or "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" is null then null else "Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A" - "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" end
fields.label: Net premium change vs ~3 months earlier ($)
fields.name: Bill_Net_Change_3m

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A" is null or "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" is null or "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" <= 0 then null else 100 * ("Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A" - "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A") / "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" end
fields.label: Net premium change vs ~3 months earlier (%)
fields.name: Bill_Net_Change_3m_Pct

fields.formulaExpression: "Bill.Bill_Gross_Latest_A"
fields.label: Gross premium, latest invoice
fields.name: Bill_Gross_Latest_F

fields.formulaExpression: coalesce("Bill.Bill_Count", 0)
fields.label: Invoices before snapshot
fields.name: Bill_Count_F

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c" > 20 or ("Acct.Off.Policy_Renewal_Rate_c__c" - coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0) > 0 and 100 * coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0) / ("Acct.Off.Policy_Renewal_Rate_c__c" - coalesce("Acct.Off.Increase_Amount_Dollars_c__c", 0)) > 10) then 'PRICE_SHOCK' when "Bill.Bill_Net_Latest_A" - "Bill.Bill_Net_Prior_A" > 20 then 'PRICE_SHOCK' when "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A" - "Drv.Drv_Discount_Prior_A" < -5 or "Drv.Drv_Score_Latest_A" - "Drv.Drv_Score_Prior_A" < -5 then 'DISCOUNT_EROSION' when Tenure_Days < 180 then 'NEW_CUSTOMER' when ("App.Last_App_Event" is null or datediff("Cal.Snap_Date", "App.Last_App_Event") > 60) and coalesce("Email.Email_Opens_90d", 0) = 0 then 'DISENGAGED' when "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A" is not null and "Drv.Drv_Discount_Latest_A" < 5 then 'LOW_SAVINGS' else 'GENERAL' end
fields.label: Primary churn reason (priority: price shock, discount erosion, new customer, disengaged, low savings, general)
fields.name: Churn_Reason

fields.formulaExpression: case when "App.Last_App_Event" is not null and ("Email.Last_Email_Event" is null or "App.Last_App_Event" >= "Email.Last_Email_Event") and ("Tkt.Last_Ticket" is null or "App.Last_App_Event" >= "Tkt.Last_Ticket") then "App.Last_App_Event" when "Email.Last_Email_Event" is not null and ("Tkt.Last_Ticket" is null or "Email.Last_Email_Event" >= "Tkt.Last_Ticket") then "Email.Last_Email_Event" else "Tkt.Last_Ticket" end
fields.label: Max feature date (audit: must be <= Snap_Date)
fields.name: Max_Feature_Date

fields.formulaExpression: case when "Acct.Latest_Offer_Date" > "Cal.Snap_Date" then 1 else 0 end
fields.label: Audit: offer dated after snapshot (must be 0)
fields.name: Offer_After_Snapshot
